guitar.modelsText: ESP Explorer-style / ESP KH models / Gibson Explorer
guitar.evidence: James Hetfield's ESP Explorer-style "Iron Cross" guitars and Kirk Hammett's ESP KH signature models (and earlier Jackson/Gibson Flying V/Explorer use) are extensively documented.

tone.target: sustaining lead fuzz/distortion with singsong mid focus
tone.profile: sustaining lead fuzz/distortion with singsong mid focus
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing Fuzz/Distortion, followed by a powerful British amp model (UK 800) and a robust 4x12 cabinet to achieve sustained, fat, mid-heavy lead tones.

blocks.purpose: Slight boost to push the high-gain stage and enhance note bloom.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for general tone shaping rather than a specific OD/Boost pedal.
